description:
Chase Payment Technology 
 Location: 14221 Dallas Parkway (Tollway and Spring Valley) 

 This opportunity will be heavily involved in working with classic ASP, not .NET. 

 Role: Classic ASP/.Net Developer 

 Top Skills: Classic ASP Dot Net; SQL Server; Oracle; SQL Queries and Prioritization; Remediation 

 Reason Open: He has to re-mediate 48 applications in an MVS Cyber Security remediation and also an IE 11 remediation to make his applications compatible; the business wants it ideally by November but he said that’s close to 16,000 hours left of work to do by 7 people so it won't happen. 

 Business: All the applications are internal and used for reporting, operation support maintenance for merchants, workflow management, add service request.
 Nice to Haves: SSRS reporting; doing their own testing of development
 Non-technical: good communication (the manager has a Masters in Comm so effective communication is important to him)
 This opportunity will be heavily involved in working with classic ASP, not .NET. 
 Selected candidate will be critical to completing remediation of legacy asp coding that is no longer compatible within ASP to work with the latest version of Internet Explorer.
 Create technical design recommendations for developing and integrating programs per written specifications.
 Examine applications to ensure adherence to Application Engineering guidelines, processes, and procedures
 Utilize multiple programming languages and software technologies
 Test, modify, and implement application code
 Evaluate service level issues to diagnose and address underlying system problems and inefficiencies
 Engage third party suppliers on applications support issues.
 

 
 Good comm skills are a big priority 
 Duration:  6+ month contract (can go 18 months) 
  Interview: will have to face to face 

 
 Start date: December 3rd
